headline: Medical Inflation Looms Through 2027, OJK Warns the Insurance Industry
summary: The regulator warned that medical inflation is a challenge for health insurers through 2027. It said rising healthcare costs could increase claims.
why: Health insurers pay out claims for medical services, so rising healthcare costs directly affect their profitability.
original_headline: Inflasi Medis Mengintai hingga 2027, OJK Wanti-Wanti Industri Asuransi
